geometry_edits.rationale: Maintain a gym-appropriate long-span section family.
Keep the span oriented along the dominant length.
Add a public void/court as a new root wrapper so the hall remains in ancestry and the frontage becomes legible.
Set a modest carved margin for the court to improve access/publicness.
Promote the new courtyard wrapper as root so the hall is accessed through a legible public void.

graph_edits.rationale: Recast the roof/section logic away from an arbitrary cascade toward a clearer long-span hall expression.
Keep a simple span family but make it read as a gym roof rather than a sculptural wedge.
Preserve the dominant linear gesture and align the hall logic along the long dimension.
Introduce a public void/entry court at the frontage edge so the ground plane becomes legible and program-responsive.
Carve a modest court to create a clear access threshold without breaking the main hall identity.

rationale: The candidate reads as one dominant elongated mass across views, so gesture clarity is decent and the form is not overly fragmented. However, the roof/section is strongly folded and angular without clearly expressing long-span gym logic, daylight structure, or a subordinate service bar. The mass also appears mostly sealed at ground level, with only tiny detached pieces and no convincing public void, court, or entry seam on the frontage edge. As a result, it feels more like an abstract sculpted wedge than a gymnasium. It is coherent in multiple views, but the spatial contract for a gymnasium—clear-span hall plus legible public threshold and section logic—is not yet satisfied.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Long, low sports datum with a readable roof edge and grounded entry sequence; useful as a precedent for linear hall dominance.
Clear hall/service hierarchy and a strong front threshold with sheltered public edge.
Legible undercut/court logic and covered public ground response; useful for carving a public void at access.
Simple sports-hall massing with a strong roof line and open court-like perimeter condition.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Counterfactual reference: do not copy its generic block composition; use only as a warning against losing the long-span hall clarity.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A more enclosed, boxy hall composition; could inform sheltered entry but not the main massing strategy here.

warnings: Hard gate fail: the visible mass does not convincingly support the gymnasium semantic contract.
Low void_publicness: frontage reads sealed rather than welcoming with court/undercut/entry seam.
Section reads as arbitrary cascading/leaning geometry instead of span/daylight logic.
The small detached volume(s) do not resolve into a clear subordinate service spine.
